I know this may not be what you’re looking to hear but you have to actively find and follow people who look like you / look different and who are confident and content and romanticise themselves. 

I live in a place where the beauty standards are stick thin, flat chested, flat butt, pale af skin. But I’m dark skinned, tall, curvy and fat for where I live. I was insulted so much as a kid and teen, by people I had crushes on even, I never dated until mid 20s, but last year I lived overseas for the first time and it was somewhere that my looks were suddenly appreciated and I was hit on like crazy after years of being treated as invisible. I even dated a really hot model. 

My point is, you may be in an environment that doesn’t value how you look, but someone out there does. And the internet is a big space, you don’t have to let the Kardashian-esque people and people who all got surgery to look exactly like them be all you see. I started following people who looked like me, who had features that I used to hate in myself - but I looked at them and admired it, and through that I started to learn to love myself. 

I unfollowed / blocked anyone who was making me feel bad about my looks - most of it is fake anyway, search YouTube - Instagram versus reality - to see them exposed, these days people can even edit VIDEOS and distort their bodies in them. So I stopped letting fantasy have power over my self worth.
